Response versus concentration plot style (plot_dvconc)

Source: R/style_presets.R
style_dvconc.Rd

Default ggstylekit::style_spec() for plot_dvconc(). Series names: obs_point, ref_line, loess, linear. The loess/linear trend lines are geom_smooth (line entity); their SE ribbon fill/alpha come from line_fill/fill_alpha.

Usage

style_dvconc(...)

Arguments

...

Fields passed to ggstylekit::style_spec(), overriding the preset defaults; call the preset with no arguments to view them. Per-series maps merge entry-wise onto the defaults; all other fields replace their default wholesale. A per-series map may instead be a palette function(n) (e.g. function(n) grDevices::hcl.colors(n, "Viridis")), which ggstylekit calls with the number of mapped groups; a palette has no entries to merge, so it replaces the default map.

Value

A ggstylekit_style_spec object.

Details

Like every pmxhelpr preset, it places legend titles above the keys (legend.title.position = "top") and applies the house theme_bw()-derived theme.

See also

Other exploratory analysis: plot_dvconc(), plot_dvtime(), style_dvtime()

Examples

style_dvconc()
#> <ggstylekit_style_spec>
#>   colors                 black, black
#>   fill                   NULL
#>   linetypes              dashed, solid , dashed
#>   alphas                 0.5, 1.0, 0.4, 0.4
